findings.message: GSAP tween uses `repeat: -1` (infinite), but the composition declares a finite 65.346s window. HyperFrames clips deterministic seeking and export to that explicit duration.
findings.fixHint: Keep the explicit finite composition `data-duration`. Use a finite repeat count only when the loop itself must end before the composition does.
